en.title: Reach the Grid Exit Within the Time Limit
en.description:
Start from the top-left corner; each second you move one step to an adjacent passable cell (up, down, left or right). Determine whether you can reach the bottom-right corner within maxTime seconds. # is impassable and . is passable; the start and end cells are guaranteed to be passable. The first line of the original first example's text was missing a #; this site completed it into a proper rectangle based on the problem's diagram.

The standard input/output format was compiled by CSWork; value ranges marked "this site" are this site's judging conventions.
en.input: The first line contains r c maxTime, followed by r lines of the grid. 1≤r≤500, 1≤maxTime≤100000; on this site the number of columns is 1..500.
en.output: Output Yes if you can reach it within the time limit, otherwise output No. Mind the capitalization.
en.explanation: Example 1: walk 5 steps along (0,0)→(0,1)→(1,1)→(2,1)→(2,2)→(2,3), so the output is Yes. Example 2: the shortest path takes 2 steps, which is less than 3, so the output is Yes. Example 3: both ways out are blocked, so the output is No.
hints: Use breadth-first search to find the shortest distance; when you reach the destination, compare it with the time limit. Layers beyond the time limit need not be expanded.
